title: refactor(Development/AutomorphicArithmetic/Foundations/Convolution): deduplicate SideTrace and TermEV helpers via TwistYA
body:
Consolidates duplicated Hilbert-space projection, eigenspace, local-operator, and adelic place helpers across `SideTrace.lean` and `TermEV.lean` into `UpperTheory.ConvolutionTheory.L1.TY` in `TwistYA.lean`, and reuses existing `L1.TY` lemmas (`prj_mem`, `prj_self`, `prj_eq_of`, `prj_star`, `prj_commute`, `prj_mul`, `mem_eigIn`, `rhoL_adj`, `rhoL_comm`, `mem_eigL`, `test_ind`, `under_of_over`, `finite_over`) directly without new imports.

Added to `UpperTheory.ConvolutionTheory.L1.TY` in `TwistYA.lean`:
- `eigIn_closed`, `prj_eigIn_comp_prj`, `isHS_prj`, `trace_sm`, `rhoL_mul`, `arch_comm`, `oloc_comm`, `oloc_fix`, `mem_fixL`, `oinf_congr`, `rho_typed`, `cmp_atFin`.

Removed duplicated private declarations and aliases:
- In `SideTrace.lean`: `under_eq`, `rho_typed`, `under_over'`, `cmp_atFin'`, `fin_above'`, `prj_mem_cl`, `prj_adj`, `prj_comm`, `eigIn_closed`, `prj_inf`, `core`, `trace_sm`, `rhoL_mul`, `rhoL_comm` (alias), `arch_comm`, `oloc_comm`, `oloc_fix`, `oinf_congr`.
- In `TermEV.lean`: `rho_typed`, `under_over'` (both copy and alias), `cmp_atFin'`, `fin_above'`, `rhoL_mul` (2 copies), `rhoL_comm` (2 copies), `arch_comm`, `oloc_comm` (3 copies), `oloc_fix` (2 copies), `mem_eigL` (2 copies), `mem_fixL`, `mem_fixL'`, `under_eq`, `prj_mem'` (both copy and alias), `prj_eq'`, `prj_self'` (both copy and alias), `comm_of_stable`, `hs_prj`, `prj_mem_cl`, `prj_mem`, `prj_self`, `prj_adj`, `prj_comm`, `eigIn_closed`, `mem_eigIn`, `mem_eigIn'` (alias), `prj_inf`, `core`, `isHS_prj`, `prj_idem`, `trace_sm`, `test_ind` (alias), `oinf_congr`, and `cmp_surj` (reusing `(cmp_homeo _ _).2`).
